summary: Onboarding Analytics Strip feature fully tested. All 6 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend OnboardingFunnelStrip renders correctly with all 4 tiles (draft, submitted, provisioned, avg-time), positioned below KPI cards and above Platform Growth chart. 'Manage packets' button navigates to Onboarding Packets section. Sidebar navigation regression test passes.

backend_analytics_summary_endpoint.details: Returns all required keys: total, by_status, draft, submitted, provisioned, rejected, avg_provision_hours, avg_review_hours, created_7d, created_30d, provisioned_7d, oldest_unprovisioned

backend_list_packets_regression.details: Returns {packets, count}, each packet has share_url and counts fields

backend_create_packet_regression.details: Creates packet with id, token, share_url, status=draft

backend_analytics_consistency.details: by_status dict values match individual draft/submitted/provisioned/rejected counts, total equals sum of by_status

frontend_funnel_strip_position.details: Strip positioned BELOW 4 KPI cards and ABOVE Platform Growth chart

frontend_funnel_tiles.details: All 4 tiles visible: funnel-draft (3), funnel-submitted (0), funnel-provisioned (1), funnel-avg-time (—)

frontend_manage_packets_button.details: 'Manage packets' button (data-testid='funnel-open-packets') visible and navigates to Onboarding Packets section

frontend_stale_alert_behavior.details: No stale alert shown (expected - no packets >72h old). Component correctly hides alert when oldest_unprovisioned.age_hours <= 72

frontend_sidebar_navigation_regression.details: Sidebar 'Onboarding Packets' navigation shows packets list panel (data-testid='admin-onboarding-packets')

critical_code_review_comments: Analytics endpoint correctly calculates avg_provision_hours and avg_review_hours from packet timestamps
oldest_unprovisioned correctly identifies the oldest draft/submitted packet with age_hours calculation
OnboardingFunnelStrip correctly hides when total=0 (returns null)
Stale alert threshold of 72 hours (3 days) is hardcoded in component - consider making configurable
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing packets: 3 draft (Muscle Factory, FitLife Wembley, Iron Gym) + 1 provisioned (TEST_Provision_Complete)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding Analytics Strip feature fully implemented and tested. Analytics endpoint returns all required metrics. Frontend strip renders correctly with 4 tiles and 'Manage packets' button. Stale alert appears when oldest_unprovisioned.age_hours > 72. Strip hides when total=0.
